attempts.plan: The legacy codebase uses binary floating-point (`double`) which causes precision loss for cent-exact calculations and fails for very large balances. I will switch the entire monetary representation to `BigDecimal` to ensure decimal precision at all scales. I will also fix the `splitPayment` logic to correctly distribute remainder cents among the first payees and ensure money is conserved.

The splitPayment method fails to maintain atomicity because it modifies the payer's balance before validating that all payee accounts exist. I will refactor splitPayment to resolve all payee accounts and verify funds before any balances are updated. I will also ensure MoneyUtil.parse rounds input amounts to two decimal places to maintain the "exact to the cent" invariant throughout all bank operations.
